purpose: Prior evidence and lessons, not reusable checkpoints for a different protocol

experiments.name: corrected-v2-day1-r2
lessons: Missing report history does not mean zero LSTM training
Complete-feature cohorts exclude zero-volume-related missing rows

experiments.name: tabular-sprint-v1
experiments.decision: Naive both horizons; reproduction max difference zero
lessons: Fixed regularization and narrow recipes do not exhaust model possibilities
Development T5 gain 0.743 percent did not transfer
21-observation refit failed predeclared comparison; retain this result, not a universal ban
Excessive regularization is an unverified hypothesis

experiments.name: research-v1
experiments.decision: Stopped in sequence diagnostic before market search
experiments.failure: Keras CPU-only RangeDataset inherited explicit GPU scope with soft placement disabled
lessons: Scope explicit GPU placement to model construction; leave Keras data adapter and saving unscoped
Assert GPU trainable-variable placement and output device separately; do not equate CPU input orchestration with CPU model training

experiments.name: research-v2-tf-placement
experiments.decision: No price model passed; preserve completed round A without rerunning
lessons: Past inner gains did not establish outer MAE superiority
Direction must be compared with past majority, not only 50 percent
Increase information content before reopening broad base-data search

experiments.name: research-market-v1
experiments.decision: Do not repeat completed ablation or open broader unchanged-information search. Review first eligible new source before enlarged search.
lessons: All four T1 feature packages failed MAE and direction gates.
T5 expanded-availability XGBoost gain 0.763 percent, direction 57.540 percent, five of eight fold wins; paired gain interval crosses zero.
Inner gain against base is 0.380 percent with five fold wins, below the predeclared 0.5 percent admission threshold.
Synthetic learnability passed; small market predictions do not alone prove a training defect.
Completed 20360 subfits cover 128 outer units; never repeat this experiment merely for a larger GPU.
Print aggregate metrics only; preserve origin records inside immutable report files.
